Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Valo Ulenor: 29-year-old man, 176 cm (medium), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: wide triangular face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; prominent bridge, compact mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: architectural high knot. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive patchwork of ordinary ink marks across the arms and upper back. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
